Computed in your browser with sidereal (Lahiri) positions, whole-sign houses and mean lunar nodes. Interpretation follows classical Parāśarī, Chaldean-Cheiro and Vāstu Śāstra conventions. This is a traditional and cultural guide, not a substitute for a qualified jyotiṣī, nor for medical, legal or financial advice. Tarot, rituals and manifestation are reflective practices, not predictions. Your details stay on your device. The one exception is Ask the Guru: when you send a question, it goes to Claude together with a summary of your chart.
